source: Seeded from the app's built-in Arizona defaults (Phoenix-area retail and fence-supply list prices, June 2026). Verify with your supplier before bidding.

settings.note: Markup is a contractor choice (0 = none). Tax is the Phoenix combined TPT rate (state 5.6% + Maricopa 0.7% + Phoenix 2.3%).

fabricRoll.note: Galvanized 9 ga, 2" mesh, 50' roll, by fence height. Big-box + fence-supply list prices, June 2026.

fabricMods.note: Dimensionless multipliers applied to the base roll price for gauge, coating and mesh size.

pipeFt.note: Galvanized SS20/SS40 fence pipe, per lineal foot, by outside diameter. Keys drop the decimal point (p2375 = 2.375").

wire.note: 7 ga galvanized tension wire and 12.5 ga 2-pt barbed wire, per lineal foot.

fit.note: Galvanized fittings and hardware, each; tbarft is tension bar per lineal foot.

gate.note: Shop-welded galvanized gate frames (fabric hung on site); walk keyed by height (ft), dbl keyed by opening width (ft).

concrete.note: Bagged concrete mix, per bag, by bag weight (lb).
